APHELION / PILOT HANDBOOK

Make yourself at home.

Your seat and cockpit stay fixed. Thrust changes your velocity; releasing the throttle lets you coast. Turning changes the direction of your next thrust, not your existing momentum.

DESKTOP

W / S throttle up / down
↑ / ↓ pitch · ← / → yaw
SPACE cannon · Q / E 15° snap turn
1 / 2 / 3 reactor / cannon / lights
X cut throttle · R reset view
Drag the canopy to look around.

META QUEST

Sit comfortably, then enter VR. Squeeze a grip near the throttle or stick to grab it. Move the handle through its mechanical range. Release the stick to center it.
Touch a switch and press trigger to flip it. Right trigger fires. Thumbstick left / right snaps your heading by 15°. Press either thumbstick to recenter the cockpit around your seat. If the hull reaches zero, press trigger to restart.

Comfort vignette starts at 2.5 m/s². No artificial head movement. All controls are within 65 cm of the seated pilot. Hold zero throttle to coast. Clear 12 asteroids to complete the contract.
